description: A function mapper. A curve drawn between movable nodes in the display maps every input voltage to an output voltage, and it works on polyphonic cables

params.text: Draws the curve between that many nodes

inputs.text: The voltage mapped through the curve

outputs.text: The input voltage after the curve has been applied to it

notes: drag a node or a control point in the display to shape the curve; hold Shift before dragging to snap a node to 0.5V steps, and hold Command while dragging to move it finely.
the curve runs through 2 to 6 nodes with a control point between each pair of them, and the positions are remembered when you change the number of nodes.
used as a waveshaper on an audio signal the curve aliases.
every node and control point can be driven by control voltage with a BZ-XPAND expander placed immediately to the right.
menu: ZOOM MODES — sets the vertical zoom of the curve display: ZOOM 100%, ZOOM 67%, ZOOM 50%, ZOOM 33%, ZOOM 25% or ZOOM 20%
CV MODES — sets the voltage range the curve maps, either 5V either way or 0-10V
